name: codex-wechat-channel
description: Bridge WeChat ClawBot messages into Codex app-server threads

scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs start
scripts.setup: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs setup
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node tools/copy-runtime-assets.mjs
scripts.probe: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs probe
scripts.bridge:start: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs bridge start
scripts.bridge:status: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs bridge status
scripts.bridge:stop: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs bridge stop
scripts.bridge:probe: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs probe
scripts.service:install: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs service install
scripts.service:status: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs service status
scripts.service:uninstall: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs service uninstall
